name: FV Refreshing Essence Foundation 30g | Moisturizing Long-Lasting Liquid Base Makeup
description:
FV Refreshing Essence Foundation is a lightweight, moisturizing liquid foundation designed to provide smooth, even coverage while caring for your skin. Formulated for all skin types, it helps control dryness, offers a natural finish, and lasts throughout the day. Its hydrating formula keeps skin soft and radiant, making it ideal for daily use or professional makeup looks.
Key Features
 Lightweight, hydrating liquid foundation for all skin types
 Provides smooth, even coverage for a natural finish
 Moisturizes and nourishes dry skin
 Long-lasting formula for all-day wear
 Ideal as a base for makeup or daily use
 Easy-to-apply pump packaging for precise control
How to Use
 Apply a small amount to clean, moisturized face
 Blend evenly with fingers, brush, or sponge
 Build coverage as needed for a flawless finish
 Follow with setting powder or makeup routine
Material
Liquid foundation with moisturizing and skin-nourishing ingredients
Safety Information
 For external use only
 Avoid contact with eyes
 Keep out of reach of children
 Discontinue if irritation occurs
Package Includes
 1 × 30g FV Refreshing Essence Foundation Pump
